niche_preference_profile: Prefers interfaces that feel calm, polished, and editorial, with soft rounded surfaces, low-contrast containment, generous breathing room, and clear hierarchy. They often favor minimal chrome, focused onboarding, and layouts that feel spacious rather than busy. In some contexts they also respond positively to darker, more cinematic and personality-rich treatments when those designs create stronger hierarchy, richer content visibility, and a more immersive premium mood.

criteria.description: Prefers open spacing, relaxed vertical rhythm, and layouts that feel airy and calm rather than tightly stacked or compressed.
Prefers soft rounded cards and subtle low-contrast surfaces that blend gently into the background instead of sharp, clinical, or aggressively separated panels.
Prefers onboarding and intro screens with a large immersive hero, guided editorial presentation, and a clearly prioritized focal module rather than fragmented checklist-like or control-heavy intros.
Prefers fewer UI modules, restrained labels, subtle progress/branding, and less persistent interface chrome so content remains the main focus.
Prefers a calmer, friendlier, more lifestyle-oriented and approachable presentation over technical, instructional, corporate, or alarmist expression.
